minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, April 17, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, April 17, 2019.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Lorraine Missick, Terry Kistler, Scott Snider, and
  Chick Campo
  Members absent: George Borst
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre, Staff Liaison and Brandon Granillo, Recreation
  Coordinator
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, March 20,
  2019 meeting. Motion carried.
2. Guest Speaker – Eric Scherer, Director of Community Development

  Eric brought us up-to-date on all the changes going on in La Verne. He spoke about
  Sierra La Verne Country Club. The person who bought the golf course has a history
  of buying and closing down golf courses. The City can’t stop closure but it is zoned
  for agriculture and open space. City Council not interested in having space
  developed. The City can only make sure it is maintained.

  He also gave us an update on other properties in the City including new housing
  units. The property at the corner of Wheeler and Foothill will be torn down and it will
  become a Taco Bell. Additionally, he talked about other changes around the City
  and at the University of La Verne. Mentioned there will be updates at the City
  Council Meeting on April 29th at 4:30 PM in the Council Chambers.
  Unfinished Business
3. Nutrition Program: Average of 37 served for the month of March.

4. Bingo Report: March – No report.

5. Meals on Wheels: 39 participants, 650 meals served in March.

6. Account Balance: The account has been changed to two accounts, purchasing and
  revenue. The balance is $6,322.52

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Senior Pinochle has not paid for March.
 8. Community Senior Services: No Report. Transportation will be available in La Verne
  now. Pomona Valley Transit Authority will be opening an office on the corner of D
  Street and Foothill Blvd. Will offer discounts for seniors.

9. Mt. SAC: No Report.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Monday, May 13th – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Mother’s Day Theme),
  11:30 AM
  Sunday, May 19th – Senior Dinner Dance Extravaganza, 5:00-8:00 PM
  Wednesday, May 29th – Volunteer Recognition Luncheon, 10:30 AM

11. Facilities Report: Nothing to report.

12. Public Comments: Brandon notified us the back bathrooms will be locked Monday-
  Friday.

  Scott informed us the story of La Verne is now being displayed at Hillcrest.

  Lorraine gave update on Pomona Valley Hospital. The hospital is now in the top 10
  best hospitals. They are now helping transients and letting them use the bathrooms
  to clean up and change clothes, etc. They have a time limit.

13. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:25 AM. Motion approved. The next
  meeting will be Wednesday, May 15, 2019 at 10:00 AM.
